# Repository Instructions

For every request, use the repository's Kiro instruction files under `.kiro/` as the source of truth.

Before acting, read all applicable `.kiro/steering/*.md` files, especially:

- `.kiro/steering/project.md`
- `.kiro/steering/coding-standards.md`
- `.kiro/steering/testing.md`

For implementation tasks, also read relevant language, API, and feature guidance under `.kiro/steering/` and task specifications under `.kiro/specs/`.

Do not duplicate or override Kiro instructions here. If this file conflicts with an instruction under `.kiro/`, follow `.kiro/`.
